temporal_description: Annual composite; not an image acquired on the request date. Represents 2000 epoch, predates Starbase construction.
output: 1024x1024 JPEG, EPSG:4326 north-up; roughly 22 km north-south by 20 km east-west, resampled
attribution: We acknowledge the use of imagery provided by services from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), part of NASA's Earth Science Data and Information System (ESDIS).
limitations: Visual imagery only, not terrain elevation or collision. Current facilities and coastal changes are not represented; JPEG/compositing artifacts and scaling apply. Earth curvature and latitude-dependent east-west scaling require proper projection or local approximation.
